_comment: Copy to roster.json in your project folder (next to the scripts folder). 'roles' pins callers who only work one pipeline so their calls always route to the right rubric: cold_call | lead_management | closing. 'excluded' hides departed callers from coaching review. 'manager' is printed on every per-dialer record; 'dialers' each get a record even before their first coached call; 'aliases' map the name heard on a call (callers often use phone aliases) to the dialer, so one person's calls fold into one record. Unmapped aliases get their own record and are listed in the manager index.
